query: Will I still be considered opted-in if I stop doing platform work for a period of time or change platform operator after opting-in?
reference_answer: Yes, your opt-in status is permanent after opting in and applies to all platform operators you work with.
answer: If you stop working on a platform or switch platform operators after opting in, you will likely remain considered opted-in unless you explicitly opt out. However, specific details depend on the platform's terms and conditions, which are not provided here. [Document N]
